def test_point_vel_calculation():
    q = dynamicsymbols('q')
    qd = dynamicsymbols('q', 1)
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    A = N.orientnew('A', 'Axis', [q, N.z])
    P = Point('P')
    Q = Point('Q')
    r = q * A.x + 2 * q * A.y
    Q.set_pos(P, r)
    P.set_vel(N, 0)
    assert Q.vel(N) == qd * A.x + 2 * qd * A.y
    # Test with a moving reference point
    P.set_vel(N, N.x)
    assert Q.vel(N) == N.x + qd * A.x + 2 * qd * A.y
